svg.title: Architecture
svg.desc: Data from schools.gpkg and synthetic scripts is ingested in six steps into three Elasticsearch indices; GeoServer serves map layers; the Streamlit app runs pipeline.answer() against Elasticsearch, GeoServer and a local llama-server.
svg.text: Everything runs on one 16 GB laptop. Every port is bound to 127.0.0.1.
md, txt, PDF page by page
